title: Uncovering inequalities in new knowledge learning by large language models across different languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparities in large language models' ability to acquire new knowledge across 17 high-resource and low-resource languages. The study measures effectiveness (efficiency and accuracy), transferability, prioritization (when facts conflict between languages), and robustness to misinformation using both fine-tuning and in-context learning on a custom multilingual parallel dataset of fictional new knowledge and a common-sense dataset.
